narrative.overview: AutoYout is built as a precision workstation for creators producing and localizing video at industrial scale. The interface channels the clarity, gravity, and control of a mission-critical broadcast master suite: deep obsidian surfaces, crisp 1px structural framing, and focused cybernetic sky-blue illuminations.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian Depth: Deep space slate (#060A12 base, #0C1424 surfaces) eliminates eye fatigue.
Luminous Precision: High-frequency interactions ignite with Cyber Sky (#0EA5E9).
Tactile Certainty: Strict corner radii (16px down to 8px) and 1px micro-borders.
Workflow Continuity: Synchronized language lanes guide operators seamlessly.

rules.name: The Luminous Focus Rule
rules.body: The obsidian base canvas dominates ≥85% of visual area. Cyber Sky (#0EA5E9) is strictly reserved for actionable controls and active states, never exceeding 15% of total screen area.

rules.name: The Timecode Monospace Rule
rules.body: Any timestamp, audio duration, frame position, or log output must render exclusively in Cascadia Mono/Consolas to prevent horizontal jitter during playback.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit flat in rest state without heavy blur shadows. Depth is communicated exclusively through surface luminance steps and luminous edge definition.

dos: Do maintain a strict 1px border on all floating containers and input fields.
Do position newly added assets or stickers directly at the top of the layer stack.
Do format all timecodes and durations with fixed-width Cascadia Mono/Consolas fonts.
Do use the triple-stop green gradient (#16A34A -> #10B981 -> #0D9488) exclusively for major pipeline execution triggers.
Do preserve full contrast and color pairing parity when switching between Dark Mode and Light Mode.
donts: Don't apply diffuse blur drop shadows; delineate depth purely through surface luminance steps and crisp 1px borders.
Don't saturate greater than 15% of the total viewport with accent colors (#0EA5E9 / #38BDF8).
Don't use arbitrary corner radiuses; adhere strictly to the 16 / 14 / 12 / 10 / 8 / 6 / 4px scale.
Don't hide or obscure critical error messages; display descriptive fault details in #F87171 accompanied by icon feedback.
Don't change component backgrounds on hover without simultaneously updating the border tone.
